analyst.summary: eClerx provides higher-value data analytics, automation and process-management services to large global enterprises, and its numbers back up the quality story: profit grew faster than revenue in FY26 (36% vs 22%), margins have stayed healthy and stable, and returns on capital are excellent (ROE ~26%, ROCE ~34%) - all on a reasonably conservative balance sheet and a valuation that is not stretched relative to the growth on offer. The main thing we could not verify in this pass is how concentrated revenue is among its largest clients, a normal feature of this business model worth keeping in view. Overall one of the stronger, more balanced profiles in this review - a Hold, with real quality underpinning it.
